title: PHP Foundation Security Releases – November 19, 2026
description: On November 19, 2026, the PHP Foundation released security updates for PHP versions 8.2.36, 8.3.37, 8.4.28, and 8.5.13 addressing 17 security issues affecting multiple components including the PHP engine, PHP-FPM, PHP CGI binary, and various extensions and stream wrappers. These updates fix vulnerabilities across the PHP 8.2 to 8.5 branches. Applying these patches is the only complete remediation.
